parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
9:17 PM

Parso Fri 23 Oct ke liye kal subah tak order kar do, taaki bakery ko time mile. Ye options mummy ke liye achhe rahenge:

Chocolate truffle: rich aur sabko pasand aane wala.
Pineapple ya fresh fruit cake: halka aur fresh, tyohaar jaisa feel.
Butterscotch: crunchy aur classic, kabhi galat nahi jaata.
Photo cake: mummy ki pasandida photo ke saath, dil jeet lega.

Mummy ko eggless chahiye ya kam meetha? Bata do, main usi hisaab se aur seedha chun dunga.
